4.1.original_text: The repositories at The National Archives hold a variety of legislation which can be viewed in the Reading Rooms. Please see the guidance [Looking for Records of Parliament](http://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/records/looking-for-subject/parliament.htm) available on The National Archives website as well as [Privy Council since 1386](http://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/records/research-guides/privy-council-correspondence.htm) which includes information about how to locate local statutory instruments (also see information on local statutory instruments further down this section). To view original documents, you will need to obtain a reader's ticket by bringing two forms of identification with you when you visit. For further details please see the [Before You Visit](http://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/visit/before-you-visit.htm) pages on The National Archives website where you can also find details about [Ordering Documents in Advance](http://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/visit/advance-orders.htm).
